field.break_contact: reform when command/control or objective geometry is lost

assault.risk: accept short exposure for decisive local control, not uncontrolled pursuit

priorities: gain information without revealing main body
avoid decisive engagement unless mission requires
recon.break_contact: disengage after compromise when information value exceeds contact value

priorities: withdraw before support loss becomes irrecoverable
support.frontage: no default assault frontage unless explicitly committed

command.rule: do not personally absorb more units/people than command capacity when qualified delegation exists

medical.frontage: no default assault frontage; self-defense or deliberate combat commitment only
medical.casualty_rule: medical losses reduce treatment/extraction capacity before they are counted as ordinary line-combat losses

priorities: maintain supply custody and route continuity
deliver ammunition/tools/food/medical stocks to the correct recipient
withdraw or reroute before service collapse
logistics.frontage: no default assault frontage; self-defense or deliberate combat commitment only

priorities: restore broken links before expanding the network
communications.frontage: no default assault frontage; communications supports command but does not itself become the commander
